rules.message: Nuclear call with a secretory signal peptide: a protein entering the ER lumen cannot reach the nucleus.
C-terminal KDEL/HDEL retention motif without an N-terminal signal peptide: retention needs prior ER entry.
Signal peptide and mitochondrial transit peptide both scored > 0.5: these N-terminal signals are mutually exclusive.
Transmembrane helix predicted but top location is extracellular / periplasm.
Peroxisomal PTS1 tripeptide present together with a signal peptide.
Closest reference homolog (>= 40% identity) is annotated to a different compartment.
